name: Anti-Mi-2 Dermatomyositis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Bohan and Peter Criteria (modified for dermatomyositis)

criteria.description: Presence of anti-Mi-2 autoantibodies in serum
Typical dermatomyositis skin manifestations including heliotrope rash and Gottron's papules
Symmetric proximal muscle weakness affecting limb girdle muscles
Elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) or aldolase levels
Muscle biopsy showing perifascicular atrophy and inflammation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of anti-Mi-2 antibodies plus characteristic skin rash and proximal muscle weakness
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Muscle biopsy and elevated muscle enzymes support diagnosis but are not mandatory if clinical and serologic criteria are met.

pathognomonic.notes: Violaceous papules over extensor surfaces of joints
Violaceous rash on upper eyelids with periorbital edema
Weakness predominantly affecting shoulder and hip girdle muscles

common.notes: Skin rash worsens with sun exposure
Hyperkeratotic, fissured skin on lateral and palmar aspects of fingers
Difficulty swallowing due to oropharyngeal muscle involvement

occasional.notes: Calcium deposits in skin and subcutaneous tissue
Mild to moderate pulmonary fibrosis or inflammation
Vasospasm of digits triggered by cold or stress

rare.notes: Voice changes due to laryngeal muscle involvement

laboratory: Presence of anti-Mi-2 antibodies detected by immunoassay
Elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) and aldolase
Elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) in some cases
imaging: MRI of muscles showing edema and inflammation
High-resolution CT chest for interstitial lung disease evaluation
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; autoimmune etiology
other: Muscle biopsy showing perifascicular atrophy and perivascular inflammation

distinguishingFeatures: More diffuse muscle inflammation without perifascicular atrophy
Presence of rimmed vacuoles on muscle biopsy

redFlags: Severe dysphagia with risk of aspiration
Signs of interstitial lung disease or respiratory compromise
references: Dalakas MC. Inflammatory Muscle Diseases. N Engl J Med. 2015;372(18):1734-1747.
Bohan A, Peter JB. Polymyositis and dermatomyositis (first of two parts). N Engl J Med. 1975;292(7):344-347.
Betteridge Z, McHugh N. Myositis-specific autoantibodies: an important tool to support diagnosis of myositis. J Intern Med. 2016;280(1):8-23.
